description:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

The role

As Integrated Campaign Manager, you are the bridge between Product Marketing, Brand & Comms and Revenue Marketing. You build one strategy for each campaign and run it across every channel, with the product as a core pillar of demand and one pipeline goal across them all. You make the calls when teams pull in different directions, and you own the plan and the result. You report to the VP of Marketing.

What you'll own

  • One integrated campaign strategy. Each campaign gets a single plan across brand, comms, demand generation, field events and ABM, built with Product Marketing, Brand & Comms and Revenue Marketing from the start rather than handed off between them. Decide which segments and ICPs it serves, set its pipeline goal, and give every channel its role in reaching it.

  • Product-led demand. Turn product capabilities and launches into campaigns that give buyers a reason to act, working from Product Marketing's positioning.

  • Execution of the whole plan. Own each campaign from brief to launch, with one brief per campaign (the metric, the owner and the date) and one calendar across every campaign. Manage the sequencing and dependencies, and make the call when something slips, so it lands as one campaign, on plan.

  • Results. Report campaign-sourced and influenced pipeline against goal, run retros, and change the plan when the data says so.

  • A model that scales. As Fieldguide adds segments, product lines and ICPs, build the playbooks and workflows that let more campaigns run at once without adding more coordination.

What you bring

  • You have run campaigns across brand, comms, demand generation, field events and ABM to a single pipeline goal, and you can show the result against that goal.

  • You are a campaign strategist: you can explain why a campaign served the segment and buying committee it did, and you write briefs people can execute without a follow-up meeting.

  • You have used product as a reason to buy, turning capabilities into demand programs, not just announcements.

  • You have run campaigns across multiple segments or regions at the same time.

  • You have landed campaigns across teams you didn't manage: you held the plan and the dates, and made the call when something slipped.

  • You own the outcome past your own lane, set the metric before launch, and report against it.

Nice to have

  • You have marketed to accounting, audit or other professional services firms.

  • You have run campaigns and attribution hands-on in HubSpot.

  • You have worked closely with designers, copywriters and other creatives to make campaigns perform better.

  • You have built AI agents or workflows that removed coordination work.

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

  • Flexible PTO

  • 401k

  • Wellness benefits

  • Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

  • Flexible work schedules
